route_rationale: Phase 2 modifies GMDW's governance enforcement plane itself. files_impacted=3: new gmdw/accept.py, a rewritten subagentstop_validate.py adapter, the wf CLI (transition liveness + a new wf accept subcommand), state.py, tests/test_governance.py, and docs (5-7 files). architectural=3: the core change is relocating artifact-acceptance authority from the SubagentStop hook into repository-scoped core and adding a mid-run liveness predicate -- a deliberate responsibility re-layering. security=2: this is the enforcement code that gates every artifact; a defect could accept ungoverned work, and wf accept is a new privileged state-mutating command with a liveness bypass -- so the security override flag is set, forcing full route with plan and code security reviews. data_model=1: no schema or state-shape changes (only a new ledger actor value and event; a test-only heartbeat seed). integrations=1: internal only (Claude Code hooks, wf CLI, ledger). testing=2: behavior-preserving refactor needs the existing suite as oracle plus new wf accept and mid-run-liveness tests. Total 12 (>8) already routes to full; the security flag independently forces full.
